AboutOddsBoss is software for US sports bettors. It finds games where two sportsbooks disagree on price, so you can back both sides and be covered whichever team wins. It scans 17 sportsbooks, exchanges and markets, pre-match and live, and works out the stake for each side. Also inside: promo conversion, middles, low holds, +EV, market moves, pro bettor signals, AI analysis, prediction markets and a bet tracker: 25 tools, ranked for your books on the Daily Card. You see both prices and both stakes before you place anything, and you place every bet yourself, at your own books, with your own money. We never take bets or hold your money. Free plan available, and 7 days free on every paid plan. Both sides only cover each other when both bets go in at the listed prices, and prices move fast. Results vary, and every bet carries risk. 21+ only. Gambling problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER. OddsBoss is software, not a sportsbook.

OddsBossThu Oct 29, 5:00 pm ET · Public

Whichever team wins, you're covered. That's arbitrage. Two sportsbooks put different prices on the same game. Back one side at each, sized right, and either result comes back ahead of what you staked. Example: Book A has Over 221.5 total points at +140. Book B has the Under at −125. With $214 on the Over and $286 on the Under ($500 in total), the Over returns $513.60 and the Under returns $514.80. You don't need to pick a winner, follow the team, or even know the sport. OddsBoss scans 17 books and markets, pre-match and live, shows the pair as soon as it opens and works out the stake for each side. Most gaps are small, usually 3% or less of the stake, and they close fast, so place both sides right away at the listed prices. See how it works: https://macaroniidev.github.io/oddsboss/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=page_launch&utm_content=P1#how Example only. Every bet carries risk. 21+ only. Gambling problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER. OddsBoss is software, not a sportsbook.

You don't have to pick a winner to bet on a game. Arbitrage backs both sides at two different books. When the prices are far enough apart, the two bets together come back ahead of what you staked, whichever team wins. You don't need to follow the team, or even the sport. OddsBoss Pre-Match Arbitrage lists every pair across 17 books and markets, ranked, with the stake for each side. It takes 30 to 60 minutes a day, best in the hour before games start, and works best with about $2,000 spread over 3+ books. Arbitrage covers you whichever team wins, as long as both bets go in at the listed prices. Three habits keep it that way: 1. Place both sides right away. A gap only lasts while one book is slow to move its price. 2. Check both stakes before you tap. OddsBoss works them out for you. 3. Spread your action. Some books cut your max bet eventually, so OddsBoss covers 17 books and markets, including exchanges like Novig and ProphetX.
